title: Editorial Magazine Grid
description: Swiss editorial typography grid with hero lede column, multi-column prose flow, and pull-quote sidebars.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Asymmetric
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Passive Magazine Columns: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
